data.SummaryOfActivities: We supported the purpose and objectives of the National Gallery of Australia, to build the national collection of art and share it as widely as possible with all Australians, no matter where they live. Through active stewardship and fundraising activities, we secured donated funds to support priority projects including the National Sculpture Garden and major exhibitions such as 'Cezanne to Giacometti' and the 5th National Indigenous Art Triennial 'After the Rain'.
